title: TD(0) on the random walk
brief: Update a value estimate after every step toward a bootstrapped target, learn the random walk's values online, and see TD(0) beat constant-step Monte Carlo.
hints: The TD target is r + gamma * V[s2] * (not terminated). Forgetting the terminal mask bootstraps from a state that has no future.
In td0_prediction, copy the update from td0_update: draw the action with rng.choice(A, p=pi[s]), step with mdp.sample(s, a, rng), then call td0_update with done = bool(mdp.terminal[s2]).
batch_td0 must hold V fixed for a whole sweep. Add each alpha * delta into a separate array, then add that array to V once the sweep ends.
